Completed

[17 August 2026, 2-4 — Siddharth Saminathan]

Blocked or At Risk

- Himaya · MCP Authentication and Connectivity: Himaya has used MCP but struggles to explain how to authenticate with it or how an external system (like Siddharth's) would connect to her local MCP instance without manual intervention.
